NTUC FairPrice Weekly Promotions

Enjoy greater value on your groceries with the latest weekly offers on a wide range of products: fresh fruits, vegetables, meat and seafood; rice, noodles and other cooking ingredients; frozen food; snacks and drinks; household essentials; cleaning products; health and wellness items; beer, wine and spirits; cookware and more!

Browse FairPrice’s shoppable store weekly ads to find new deals and promotions. Don’t miss our 1-day, 2-day, 3-day or 4-day special offers! Plus, get updates on the latest Purchase with Purchase promotions to make your grocery shopping more rewarding.

You can hop between each catalogue to view items that are on discount, from Must Buy deals and Fresh Buys to Weekly Savers, Neighbourhood Deals (4-day offers that start on Thursday) and more! When you’ve found a product you’re interested in, simply select it. You can then save it to your shopping list on the FairPrice Group app and purchase it from your preferred store, or shop online at FairPrice and have it delivered right to your doorstep.

Greater Value Every Day

With FairPrice, you can shop smarter and save more on your groceries and daily necessities! The Everyday Low Price scheme enables you to enjoy a price freeze on 50 selected popular essential items every month, while the Price Drop Buy Now scheme offers weekly discounts of up to 50% on selected products.

Stretch your dollar further with our discount schemes; you can enjoy even more savings daily if you’re an NTUC Union, FairPrice or Link member, or on designated days if you’re a senior citizen (aged 60 and above), a Pioneer or Merdeka Generation cardholder or a CHAS Blue cardholder.

NTUC Union and Link members can also enjoy exclusive 50% off deals every week (Union deals). Simply present your Link Rewards card or the FairPrice Group app to enjoy the deals. You can also pay with your NTUC Link Card or Trust Link Card to enjoy the promotions. With the Trust credit card, you save up to 21% on FairPrice Group groceries and food when you hit the minimum spend anywhere outside FairPrice Group. Don’t have a Trust card yet? Sign up with Trust, the digital bank by Standard Chartered and FairPrice Group.

About NTUC FairPrice

Founded by the labour movement in 1973, NTUC FairPrice’s social mission is to moderate the cost of living in Singapore. From one supermarket, it has grown to become a leading retailer in Singapore, serving more than half a million shoppers daily through a network of over 370 outlets. It comprises FairPrice supermarkets and e-commerce portal, FairPrice Finest, FairPrice Xtra, FairPrice Shop, Cheers convenience stores, FairPrice Xpress and Unity pharmacy.
